lsprobe|v1|section|create|logs.a2_awkward
a2_awkward	"CREATE TABLE a2_awkward (
  event_time VARCHAR NULL,
  severity_text VARCHAR NULL,
  service VARCHAR NULL,
  content VARCHAR NULL,
  latency_ms VARCHAR NULL,
  request_id VARCHAR NULL,
  code BIGINT NULL,
  attrs VARIANT NULL,
  resource VARIANT NULL,
  tags ARRAY(VARCHAR NULL) NULL,
  SYNC INVERTED INDEX idx_content (content, attrs) filters = 'english_stop,english_stemmer', tokenizer = 'english',
  SYNC NGRAM INDEX idx_content_ng (content)
) ENGINE=FUSE"
